notes: Landscape, straight-on, three wooden bookstalls on a pavement (Plaza de Armas, Havana) in overcast daylight, no glare, the far right partly blocked by a cardboard box; the stalls are a few metres away so covers read only at full resolution. Spanish throughout except two English Fidel Castro speech collections (Cold War, The World Economic and Social Crisis). The two left-hand stalls hold old leather-bound sets whose spines carry no readable titles; the readable books are the face-out paperbacks on the right stall and along the bottom shelves (three crops). Obra poética 1958-1972 (Nicolás Guillén) is labelled with its volume as printed (Tomo II). Corrections to the draft: 'Che' alone is not a title, 'Economía Política' is Apuntes críticos a la Economía Política, 'La otra vez' is printed Otra vez, 'Afrocubano' is part of Folklore criollo y afrocubano. Partial: El siglo de las luces (Carpentier, lower half of the cover hidden), Vientos de cuaresma and La puerta de Alcalá (Padura, only part of each title visible). Left out: all the leather-bound sets, the Che dictionary next to Cuba la historia no contada (title too worn), the Neruda, Hemingway-cover and 'siempre' Che books on the lower right shelf (titles not resolvable), the constitution and Havana books on the fourth shelf, the books lying on the pavement, and the 'Che en tres...' cover whose title is cut. Non-book items: a cardboard box (Virginia apples), a plastic bag, kerbstones. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 85), verified by an agent.
